nodes.title: WATERMARKS AND GHOST WATERMARKS
widgets_values:
WATERMARKS :

I included a double protection for your creations.

Watermark (Normal)
It will add your logo or whatever in the image.
Please don't forget to provide the size of the logo.

Ghost Watermark (Stealth Watermark)
This will add another watermark BUT invisible,
for Humans eyes. i will add that system on every upcoming workflow that i will create.

To be more precise : 
A Ghost watermark helps protect intellectual property by embedding hidden ownership information in media. 
It enables content authentication, detecting tampering if the watermark is altered or missing. Watermarks also allow tracking of media use, tracing unauthorized copies. 
Since they are invisible, they don’t affect media quality. They remain robust against modifications and aid in forensic analysis for piracy cases. Your Media is protected Buddy <3


To turn it off, Just set the "Transparency" to "0".

If you like my work..
you know what it need To be done :D <3 T_T
